retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a central subject with floating currency elements and large, distressed display typography against a dark, textured background.
excludeWhen: bright pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait of a young man in athletic wear, framed by large-scale distressed typography at the top and dynamic, motion-blurred currency notes floating in the foreground, all set against a dark, heavily textured charcoal background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head overlapping the primary title text
Floating currency creates a sense of depth and motion through varying scales and blur
High-contrast lighting on the subject against a dark, low-detail background
Typography color gradient mirrors the lighting or thematic tones of the subject's clothing
coreInvariants: Heavily distressed or 'grunge' texture applied to the entire composition
Large, bold, condensed sans-serif title text
Dark, monochromatic background with subtle industrial or basketball-court motifs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright gold jewelry at the center of the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large title text, moves down to the subject's face, follows the floating money to the bottom right, and circles back through the jersey details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the edges and top corners to emphasize the central figure and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and light grey for the jersey and skin highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gradient of burnt orange to royal purple within the typography and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with desaturated background tones and selective high-saturation accents in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary greens or yellows

characterSpecificRedesigns: Heavy distressing and 'eroded' edges applied to all glyphs
Gradient fill spanning the entire word block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A massive, distressed display font paired with a clean, widely-spaced secondary font for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight and vertical presence.
Good skeleton for the secondary wide-tracked text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, dark charcoal background with subtle basketball hoop silhouettes and a central portrait of a young man in a white mesh jersey with blue/red trim. Add floating, motion-blurred currency notes in the foreground and a heavy grunge texture overlay across the whole image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, condensed, distressed uppercase text across the top, using an orange-to-purple gradient. Place a smaller, clean, widely-spaced uppercase line of text above the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text distressed and eroded?
Does the subject overlap the main title?
Are the floating notes blurred to show depth?
Is the background dark and textured?

adjustableVariables: Amount and placement of floating currency
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text gradient is smooth and vibrant.
Ensure the grunge texture doesn't obscure the subject's face.
Verify the floating notes look like they are in motion.
Confirm the hierarchy between the two text elements is clear.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Distressed Condensed Type + Floating Objects + Grunge Overlay
